name: SocialPilot
description_en:
SocialPilot is a managed social media workspace for preparing, scheduling, reviewing and reporting on connected accounts. Its Social Media product combines a calendar, platform-specific captions, account queues, team/client workflows, bulk CSV import, analytics and an MCP connection for AI-assisted actions. Reviews and Listings appear as separate products; their capabilities should not be assumed included in a social publishing subscription.

It is a candidate for an agency coordinating several clients or a small team that wants publishing and reporting in one workspace. The decisive checks are operational: whether the right account receives each version, which person can approve it, how a CSV maps to accounts, and what happens when authorization or media fails. The public client-approval workflow still permits manager approval without a client decision. This profile reviews documentation, not an account trial, native publication test or independently measured engagement result.
description_zh:
SocialPilot 是面向已连接账户准备、排程、审核及报告的托管社交媒体工作区。Social Media 产品结合日历、平台专属文案、账户队列、团队／客户流程、批量 CSV 导入、分析，以及供 AI 辅助操作的 MCP 连接。Reviews 与 Listings 作为独立产品出现，不能假设其能力包含在社交发布订阅中。

它可供协调多客户的机构，或希望集中发布与报告的小团队评估。关键是实际流程：每份版本发到哪个账户、谁有权批准、CSV 如何映射账户，以及授权／媒体失败后如何处理。公开客户审批流程仍允许经理不经客户决定而批准。本档案核对文档，未执行账户试用、原生发布或独立互动效果测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Official July 2026 pricing Markdown lists US monthly USD 30/50/100/200 for Essentials/Standard/Premium/Ultimate; annual monthly equivalents 25.50/42.50/85/170. Global allowances: 7/15/25/50 accounts and 1/3/6/unlimited users. Current HTML interleaves different annual/monthly numerals, so rates remain a documented snapshot, not a normalized quote. India packs change account/user allowances, not merely currency. Standard adds internal approval; Premium adds client approval and bulk CSV. Enterprise is quoted with REST API/SSO. Pricing advertises a 14-day no-card trial; no permanent free plan. Billing help states prices before applicable taxes. Confirm the actual regional checkout.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方 2026 年 7 月价格 Markdown 列美国月付 USD 30／50／100／200，对应 Essentials／Standard／Premium／Ultimate；年付月均 25.50／42.50／85／170。全球额度为 7／15／25／50 账户及 1／3／6／不限用户。当前 HTML 交错显示不同年／月数字，因此仅保留文档快照，不分配标准化报价。印度套餐改变账户／用户额度，不只是换币种。Standard 增内部审批，Premium 增客户审批及批量 CSV。Enterprise 询价并含 REST API／SSO。价格页宣传 14 天免卡试用，无永久免费档；账单帮助说明未含适用税。需确认真实地区结算。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Autosave is not a saved draft
sections.title_zh: 自动保存不等于已存草稿
sections.en: The new composer shares main media across selected platforms and permits caption customization. Turning customization off replaces custom captions with main text after confirmation. Real-time autosave preserves the open composer, but does not create a saved draft. Editorial campaign setup: explicitly save the draft and inspect each customized caption after changing the common announcement.
sections.zh: 新编辑器向所选平台共享主媒体，允许定制文案。关闭定制会在确认后用主文替换专属文案。实时自动保存保留打开的编辑器，但不创建已存草稿。编辑活动设置：明确保存草稿，修改共用公告后逐份检查定制文案。

sections.title_en: Queue slots, explicit times and repetitions require different checks
sections.title_zh: 队列时段、指定时间及循环需要不同检查
sections.en: Account schedules define weekday/time slots. Add to Queue takes the next free slot; Share Next prioritizes the next available slot, while Share Now publishes immediately. Explicit scheduling and staggered timing are separate choices. Repeat supports at most ten selected accounts; daily, weekly and monthly horizons differ. The timezone troubleshooting page points to Profile → Your Profile → Date and Time. Editorial timed launch: verify account slots, timezone and every assigned time before committing, especially after switching scheduling mode. Documentation does not establish how a timezone change retroactively transforms existing queued timestamps.
sections.zh: 账户排程定义星期／时间时段。Add to Queue 使用下个空位，Share Next 优先下个可用位，Share Now 立即发布。指定时间与错峰是独立选择。循环最多选择十个账户，日／周／月循环期限不同。时区故障页指向 Profile → Your Profile → Date and Time。编辑定时上线：提交前核账户时段、时区及每个分配时间，尤其切换排程模式后。文档未确定改时区如何追溯转换已有队列时间戳。

sections.title_en: A scheduler’s post waits, but a manager’s need not
sections.title_zh: 排程员的帖子需等待，经理的未必
sections.en: Owner/Admin invite team members. Content Schedulers submit to Pending Review; Manager/Admin/Owner approval is needed before queuing. Those higher roles can create posts without that approval step. Managers may connect/remove accounts only when separately allowed; Admin does not manage subscription billing. Client publishing, analytics and inbox permissions are optional. Team roles can change, but a Client cannot be converted into a team role or vice versa. Editorial staffing: assign access to actual client accounts before inviting; do not interpret a client label as a mandatory publishing restriction. The guide retains old plan names, so current pricing must determine available seats.
sections.zh: Owner／Admin 邀请团队。Content Scheduler 提交到 Pending Review，经 Manager／Admin／Owner 批准后才能入队；较高角色自己建帖不需该审批。Manager 仅另获许可时可连接／移除账户，Admin 不管订阅账单。客户发布、分析及收件箱权限可选。团队角色可改，但 Client 与团队角色不能互转。编辑人员配置：邀请前分配真实客户账户访问，不能把客户标签理解成强制发布限制。指南保留旧套餐名，可用席位应看现行价格。

sections.title_en: Client approval is not enforced after the manager step
sections.title_zh: 经理步骤后并不强制客户批准
sections.en: A manager can approve a scheduler’s post into the queue, send it to the client, or return it with comments. Even when Need Client Approval and a client approver are configured, the guide says the manager chooses whether to seek client approval. A client can approve or return the post; after correction, the manager can approve directly or resend it. The On-The-Go portal needs no client login and exposes the assigned accounts’ calendar, queued and delivered posts, not merely one preview. Editorial agency handoff: agree on the human sign-off process and inspect portal scope before sharing; configuration alone does not guarantee the client sees the final revision.
sections.zh: 经理可将排程员帖子批准入队、送客户或附评退回。即使设置 Need Client Approval 及客户审批人，指南仍说由经理选择是否送客户。客户可批准或退回，修正后经理可直接批准或重送。On-The-Go 门户不需客户登录，呈现分配账户的日历、队列及已发帖，不仅一个预览。编辑机构交接：约定人工签认流程，分享前检查门户范围；仅配置不能保证客户看到最终修订。

sections.title_en: Scheduling and library imports use different CSV schemas
sections.title_zh: 排程与内容库导入使用不同 CSV 结构
sections.en: Bulk scheduling accepts up to 500 posts. Its positional columns cover content, public media URLs, date/time, account IDs, first comment and tags. Semicolons separate image URLs; video is single-file. Blank account IDs use the accounts selected during import, while already assigned rows retain their mapping. Only one X account is allowed. The preview permits corrections before scheduling. Import to Library instead uses content/media/comment/tags/type/title columns and saves separate reusable items. Editorial spreadsheet preparation: download the correct template and test a small preview; a library CSV is not interchangeable with a scheduling CSV, and import is not evidence of native delivery.
sections.zh: 批量排程最多 500 帖，位置列依次涉及内容、公开媒体 URL、日期时间、账户 ID、首评及标签。图片 URL 用分号分隔，视频单文件。空账户 ID 使用导入时所选账户，已分配行保留映射，只允许一个 X 账户。排程前可在预览修正。Import to Library 则用内容／媒体／首评／标签／类型／标题列，保存独立可复用项。编辑表格准备：下载正确模板并预览少量；内容库 CSV 与排程 CSV 不通用，导入也不能证明原生投递。

sections.title_en: Composer checks and runtime failures are separate stages
sections.title_zh: 编辑器校验与运行时失败是不同阶段
sections.en: The composer blocks final actions until errors are resolved; dismissible warnings are different. Its error catalog includes platform-specific truncation/conversion, such as only the first ten Instagram carousel items and a PDF-to-image cutoff. The direct-publishing guide and error catalog disagree on Instagram feed aspect ratios; do not treat either as a universal current Meta specification. Runtime Error entries can instead reflect expired authorization, lost page access, policy rejection, duplicate X content or media constraints. The recovery guide directs correction and re-sharing/rescheduling, with reauthorization where needed. Editorial recovery: retain the exact account/error and inspect the native result when uncertain before another attempt; no universal automatic retry or delivery SLA was verified.
sections.zh: 编辑器在错误解决前阻止最终操作，可关闭警告与错误不同。错误目录含平台专属截断／转换，例如 Instagram 轮播仅前十项及 PDF 转图片数量截断。直接发布指南与错误目录的 Instagram feed 比例不一致，不能将任一视为当前 Meta 通用规范。运行时 Error 还可能来自授权到期、页面权限丢失、政策拒绝、X 重复内容或媒体限制。恢复指南要求修正后重新分享／排程，必要时重授权。编辑恢复：保留准确账户／错误，不明时先查原生结果再尝试；未核普遍自动重试或投递 SLA。

sections.title_en: Pause sharing and delete a delivered post have different effects
sections.title_zh: 暂停分享与删除已发帖作用不同
sections.en: Manage Accounts can pause one account or use the header control to pause all; Running resumes sharing. The guide does not specify exact replay behavior for missed slots. Manage Posts separates Queued, Unscheduled, Error, Delivered and Pending Approval. Delivered displays the last six months; that is not proof of complete data retention. Dated drafts appear in Calendar, undated drafts do not. Native deletion from Delivered has role/platform restrictions and excludes Instagram and TikTok; disconnected or removed accounts also prevent it. Editorial incident response: pause the intended scope, inspect native posts separately, and review old times before resuming rather than treating pause as unpublishing.
sections.zh: Manage Accounts 可暂停单账户，或用页头控件暂停全部，Running 恢复分享。指南未说明错过时段的准确补发行为。Manage Posts 区分 Queued、Unscheduled、Error、Delivered、Pending Approval。Delivered 显示最近六个月，不能证明完整保留期。带日期草稿出现在 Calendar，无日期者不出现。从 Delivered 删除原生帖有角色／平台限制，排除 Instagram 及 TikTok，断开或移除账户也不能删。编辑事件响应：暂停准确范围，单独检查原生帖子，恢复前复核旧时间，不能把暂停当撤回已发内容。

sections.title_en: Report editing uses dummy data until Live Data is opened
sections.title_zh: 报告编辑在打开 Live Data 前使用演示数据
sections.en: The report editor uses dummy data; Live Data opens a real preview. Last 90 Days ends yesterday, whereas Last 3 Months means three full calendar months. Available history can extend two years, but one report covers at most three months; the guide lists shorter LinkedIn and Google Business Profile history. Meta-native and SocialPilot values can differ through calculation, attribution windows and synchronization. Organic and boosted Meta results have separate blocks. Editorial reporting: record the exact account, period and data mode before exporting. Do not present editor placeholders as customer performance or substitute zero for unavailable metrics.
sections.zh: 报告编辑器使用演示数据，Live Data 才打开真实预览。Last 90 Days 截至昨天，Last 3 Months 指三个完整日历月。可得历史可达两年，但单份报告最多三个月；指南列出较短 LinkedIn 与 Google Business Profile 历史。Meta 原生与 SocialPilot 数值可因计算、归因窗口及同步不同。Meta 自然与推广结果有独立区块。编辑报告：导出前记录准确账户、周期及数据模式，不能把编辑器占位数据呈为客户业绩，也不能用零替代不可得指标。

sections.title_en: MCP actions inherit user access and differ from the REST API
sections.title_zh: MCP 动作继承用户访问，不等于 REST API
sections.en: The MCP guide sequences account/group discovery, draft or post creation, review, and status monitoring. Tools distinguish queued, delivered, error and unscheduled posts. Agents gain no additional account/data access beyond the connected user. The pricing document lists MCP for paid plans while public REST API access is Enterprise-only. Editorial automation evaluation: identify the intended account and preserve a review point before a publishing-capable action, then inspect actual delivery state. A chat response alone is not native-publication evidence, and no connector or approval interaction was executed in this research.
sections.zh: MCP 指南顺序为发现账户／组、创建草稿或帖子、审核、监控状态。工具区分队列、已发、错误及未排程。代理不会获得超出连接用户的账户／数据访问。价格文档列付费档可用 MCP，公开 REST API 则仅 Enterprise。编辑自动化评估：明确准确账户，在可发布动作前保留审核节点，再检查真实投递状态。聊天回复本身不能证明原生发布，本研究未操作连接器或审批交互。

sections.title_en: Downgrade requires support and annual payments are excluded from refunds
sections.title_zh: 降档需支持处理，年付不退款
sections.en: The downgrade guide directs users to support and explicitly says SocialPilot Lite Free is no longer offered. A trial is not sustained free access. The refund page offers the latest charge under recent-charge/unused-plan conditions, but its one-day wording is ambiguous; it denies prorated refunds after more than a day of paid use and excludes annual plans. Eligible processing is described as five to ten business days to the currently available payment method. Editorial subscription decision: confirm the selected billing interval, regional capacity and cancellation/end date before paying. No cancellation timing, downgrade effective date or safe preservation of excess scheduled work was established.
sections.zh: 降档指南要求联系支持，并明确不再提供 SocialPilot Lite Free。试用不等于持续免费。退款页在刚扣费／未用计划条件下提供最近扣费退款，但一天相关措辞含糊；使用付费档超过一天不按比例退，年付排除退款。符合资格时说明向当前可用付款方式处理，需五至十工作日。编辑订阅决策：付款前核计费周期、地区容量及取消／结束日期。取消时点、降档生效日及超额计划工作的安全保留均未确定。

seo.title_en: SocialPilot: client approval, CSV mapping and publishing recovery
seo.title_zh: SocialPilot：客户审批、CSV 映射及发布恢复
seo.description_en: Review SocialPilot drafts, queue timing, manager discretion, bulk formats, live analytics and regional plan differences.
seo.description_zh: 核对 SocialPilot 草稿、队列时间、经理裁量、批量格式、真实分析及地区套餐差异。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate SocialPilot social publishing and client operations
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Current HTML rates and dated Markdown differ; checkout, regional entitlements, exact tax, cancellation timing and downgrade effects were not operated.
research_gaps.zh: 当前 HTML 费率与有日期 Markdown 不一致，未操作结算、地区权益、准确税、取消时点及降档效果。

research_gaps.en: Help articles retain legacy plan/platform labels; Instagram ratio/duration and rate-limit statements were not verified against current native provider documentation.
research_gaps.zh: 帮助文章保留旧套餐／平台名，Instagram 比例／时长及频率限制未对当前原生提供方文档核验。

research_gaps.en: Portal expiry/password controls, missed-slot replay, universal retry/SLA, full retention, UI languages, regional availability and source-code licensing remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 门户到期／密码、错过时段补发、普遍重试／SLA、完整保留期、界面语言、地区可用及源码许可未核。

research_gaps.en: No channel connected, CSV uploaded, account invited, MCP action, purchase, native publishing or performance test executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未连接渠道、上传 CSV、邀请账户、执行 MCP 动作、购买、原生发布或效果测试。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
